metadata.title: बिहार के आदिवासी क्यों नाराज हैं | Why Adivasis in Bihar unhappy | Tribes of Bihar
metadata.description: A delegation of Tharu Adivasis from Bihar met with President Droupadi Murmu in Delhi, led by Shailendra Garhwal, Chairman of the Bihar State Scheduled Tribes Commission. During the meeting, the delegation urged the President to implement the provisions of the Fifth Schedule in tribal-dominated regions of Bihar. They also raised a pressing issue concerning the Gond and Gord communities, alleging that members of the Gord community are misrepresenting themselves as Gonds to claim Scheduled Tribe benefits wrongfully. Main Bhi Bharat Editor Shyam Sunder spoke to the delegation about their demands and concerns.
